{{Quote|Name's Mendi Dian. I'm with the Strategic Information Service.|Mendi Dian, to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Mendi Dian''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. She investigated the [[Master's Top Secret Army]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mendi Dian appears in the [[September]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.3.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Confidence in Power">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

In the Galactic Season 5 missions, if the player is affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Vec Vennec]] will appear rather than Mendi Dian.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
